description: Dymola (Dynamic Modeling Laboratory) is Dassault Systèmes' tool for modelling and simulating integrated, complex systems, based on the Modelica language developed by the Modelica Association and on the Functional Mock-up Interface (FMI). It is a complete environment for model creation, testing, simulation and post-processing, with multi-engineering models that mix components from mechanical, electrical, control, thermal, hydraulic, thermodynamic, air-conditioning and other libraries. Components are dragged and dropped and connected graphically in the way the physical system is built, and users can write new components from scratch or from templates. Symbolic manipulation of differential algebraic equations gives the performance needed for real-time hardware-in-the-loop simulation, and interoperability covers full FMI support, Python scripting, a Simulink interface and links to Simulia products such as Abaqus and Isight. The provider lists automotive, aerospace, robotics and process applications; for buildings it is widely used to run Modelica building libraries. Coverage: generic. Access: through Dassault Systèmes sales. Licence: commercial. Caveats: the product page names no price and no building-specific features; building use relies on third-party Modelica libraries. Simulation uses: HVAC plant and control design, district energy and co-simulation with EnergyPlus through FMI. Related records: OpenModelica, the Modelica Buildings library, EnergyPlusToFMU and the BCVTB.
